source.name: CPIC
source.guidelineName: CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, SLC6A4, HTR2A and Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor Antidepressants

records.cpicRecommendationVerbatim:
Initiate therapy with recommended starting dose. If patient does not adequately respond to recommended maintenance dosing, consider titrating to a higher
maintenance dose or switching to a clinically appropriate alternative antidepressant not predominantly metabolized by CYP2C19 or CYP2B6.

cpicImplicationsVerbatim.CYP2B6: Increase in metabolism of sertraline to less active compounds when compared to CYP2B6 normal metabolizers.
cpicImplicationsVerbatim.CYP2C19: Small increase in metabolism of sertraline to less active compounds when compared to CYP2C19 normal metabolizers.

records.patientText: Your CYP2B6 and CYP2C19 results may affect how your body handles sertraline. Discuss the result with your prescriber or pharmacist.
